## New
- The notifications inbox is populated from the port's own subscription refresh instead of being permanently empty. The Subscriptions tab reads each channel's uploads; the shell now keeps the newest upload every channel had when it was last read and turns the entries published after it into inbox rows, one row per upload, newest first, capped at ten per channel and a hundred in the record, exactly the rule the reference's subscription check uses (`app/src/main/java/io/github/aedev/flow/data/subscriptions/ChannelRssParser.kt:165-176` is the reference's `newEntriesSince`; a channel never read only records its pointer, so a first visit does not mail its whole back catalogue). On device at 800 by 1340 the tab's refresh announced both subscribed channels' newest uploads and the bell opened an inbox reading **New** with two rows; `Full Set (Official Music Video) | Dhanda Nyoliwala × Xvir Grewal`, "Dhanda Nyoliwala · Just now", and `Jigyasa The Curiosity | Standup Comedy By Inder Sahani`, "Inder Sahani · Just now"; each with its 120 dp still, its unread badge dot and its two-line title, and the stored record read back the real ids `DW9F2jELRd8` and `T0iWKW2i6Z8` with `lastSeen` moved to them.
- The inbox behaves the way the reference's does: opening it takes the unread snapshot, marks the record read and keeps the rows it found marked **New** for the visit, so re-entering moved both rows under **Today** without their dots; a row tap opened the real video (`FlowPlayback: sync media=[DW9F2jELRd8]` at 12:13:35.910, `state=3` at 12:13:38.242); a right-to-left swipe removed exactly one row and offered "Notification removed · Undo", which put it back already read; and the bar's bin asked "Clear all notifications? / Remove all 2 notifications?" before the list emptied to the port's existing "Peace and quiet" state, with the clear action leaving the bar as the reference's does.
- Rows are grouped by the reference's own sections; **New**, **Today**, **Yesterday**, **Last 7 days**, **Earlier** (`NotificationGrouping.kt:20-27`, `NotificationLabels.kt:30-38`); with today's rows counting minutes and hours, yesterday's showing a clock, last week's a weekday and older ones a date, in the device's own locale.

## Fixed
- The row below a swiped one was dismissed in the same frame, because the group's rows had no keys and the next row inherited the removed row's swipe state; each row is now keyed by its video, and one swipe removes one row.
- Time lines read "1 minutes ago" and the clear-all dialog "Remove all 1 notifications?"; both are plurals now ("1 minute ago", "Remove 1 notification?").

## Fixed
- The build that shipped after the rename-only formatting pass is smoke-checked on the device instead of left blocked by the keyguard: the player opened (`state=3` at 10:59:28.017), the gear opened the Playback settings sheet, and an end-of-video hand-off reached `state=4` at 11:03:48.743, `resetQueue was=[DW9F2jELRd8]` at 11:03:48.840, `sync media=[aFssZKYEB2Q]` at 11:03:49.586 and `state=3` at 11:03:50.045 (1.30 s from the end).
- Transport on the handed-off item still holds: pause via the surface read `state=2 speed=0.0 position=189025`, resume `state=3 speed=1.0`, and a drag on the track logged `seek to 165066ms` at 12:14:58.153 with `state=2 at item=0 pos=165066` and `state=3 at item=0 pos=165070`; the frames show only the page's own bar (elapsed/total and thumb) with no platform controller.
